ios.desc:
Many keyboards are boring. Some track what you type. Plenty just don't work. Klava ain’t any of that. Klava keyboard brings together smart above-key predictions, stunning themes, sick features and rock-solid privacy. And a bunch of other cool stuff (that you can customise or turn on / off).

What Klava has that others don’t:

- Smart above-key and above-keyboard suggestions that you can flick up. Like the good ol’ BlackBerry days
- Privacy. Klava learns as you type, but what you type doesn’t ever leave the device. As it should be. Keep what's yours, we don't want to know that!
- Beautiful themes, each with unique features. We got sleek modern themes. We got nostalgic themes, true classics even. We got more themes cooking as you are reading this
- App shortcuts – a true revolution! Assign apps to keys & then jump to the app of your choice by simply long-pressing the key
- High personalisation. Customise font size, colours, buttons and so on. Make Klava what you want it to be
- Gestures that feel awesome. Our favourite: swipe left across the keyboard to delete words. Or set a custom action to the 'swipe right' gesture!
- Autocorrect is here, plus text navigation with Cursor Mode via WASD or a joystick in some themes. It’s super nice
- Built-in emojis. What’s more, type things like :) or :phone to get an instant emoji suggestion. Truly :fire (can't put emojis here, imagine one!)
- You can switch keyboard layouts by simply holding the spacebar, smooth as heck
- We could go on, but that’s probably enough for the App Store page. Last thing: we are releasing major updates for Klava at least every month, so expect more themes, features, languages and just plain new & nice stuff regularly

Klava currently supports 25+ languages with more in the making:

- English (US/GB)
- Spanish (Español)
- French (Français)
- German (Deutsch)
- Dutch (Nederlands)
- Italian (Italiano)
- Portuguese (Português)
- Russian (Русский)
- Finnish (Suomi)
- Hungarian (Magyar)
- Polish (Polski)
- Romanian (Română)
- Swedish (Svenska)
- Bulgarian (Български)
- Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia)
- Czech (Čeština)
- Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt)
- Arabic
- Danish (Dansk)*
- Croatian (Hrvatski)*
- Norwegian (Norsk)*
- Turkish (Türkçe)*
- Greek (Ελληνικά)*
- Serbian (Српски)*
- Ukrainian (Українська)*
- Hebrew* 
- Thai (ไทย)*

*These languages don't support predictions above keys just yet, but you can type in your favourite themes in your language's layout!
